"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Building, Picture, Road, Scene, Tree, Vehicle

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 85
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
road = scene.add("road", Road("gray"), size=(640, 20), at=(0, 400), layer="scenery")
building = scene.add("building", Building("brown"),
                     size=(50, 100), at=(100, 300), on="road", count=3, vary=0.25,
                     layer="scenery")
tree = scene.add("tree", Tree("green"), size=(40, 80), at=(200, 350), layer="scenery")
scene.add("player", Picture("assets/eagle.png"), rect=player, scale=1.5, layer="things")
car = scene.add("car", Vehicle(),
                size=(128, 128), at=(500, 300), moves=(-2, 0), layer="things")

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching car sends the player back to the start.
    if scene.touching(player, "car"):
        player.topleft = (WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2)
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Building, Cloud, Picture, Road, Scene, Sky, Tree, Vehicle

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 85
BACKGROUND = (60, 130, 230)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
sky = scene.add("sky", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")
cloud = scene.add("cloud", Cloud("white"),
                  size=(100, 40), at=(100, 100), count=3, vary=0.25, layer="background")
road = scene.add("road", Road("gray"), size=(640, 20), at=(0, 400), layer="scenery")
building = scene.add("building", Building("brown"),
                     size=(50, 100), at=(100, 300), on="road", count=3, vary=0.25,
                     layer="scenery")
tree = scene.add("tree", Tree("green"), size=(40, 80), at=(200, 350), layer="scenery")
scene.add("player", Picture("assets/eagle.png"), rect=player, scale=1.5, layer="things")
car = scene.add("car", Vehicle("red"),
                size=(60, 100), at=(500, 300), on="road", count=3, moves=(-2, 0),
                layer="things")

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching car sends the player back to the start.
    if scene.touching(player, "car"):
        player.topleft = (WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2)
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

PLAYER_SIZE = 85
BACKGROUND = (60, 130, 230)
COIN_COUNT = 5
COIN_SIZE = 17
COIN_COLOUR = (240, 200, 60)
COIN_DETAIL = (248, 230, 167)
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)

screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().

sky = scene.add("sky", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")

                  size=(100, 40), at=(100, 100), count=3, vary=0.25, layer="background")

building = scene.add("building", Building("brown"),

                     layer="scenery")
tree = scene.add("tree", Tree("green"), size=(40, 80), at=(200, 350), layer="scenery")
scene.add("player", Picture("assets/eagle.png"), rect=player, scale=1.5, layer="things")
car = scene.add("car", Vehicle("red"),
                size=(60, 100), at=(500, 300), on="road", count=3, moves=(-2, 0),
                layer="things")

coins = []
for i in range(COIN_COUNT):
    coin_x = random.randint(0, WIDTH - COIN_SIZE)
    coin_y = random.randint(0, HEIGHT // 3)

score = 0

while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False

            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:

    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:

    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:

    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:

        player.topleft = (WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2)

            coin.x = random.randint(0, WIDTH - COIN_SIZE)
            coin.y = random.randint(0, HEIGHT - COIN_SIZE)

    scene.draw()
    for coin in coins:
        x, y = coin.center
        size = coin.width
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, COIN_COLOUR, (x, y), size // 2)
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, COIN_DETAIL, (x, y), size // 3, 2)
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
